==Description==
'''Easter Engineer Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 29 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{Bunz|980}} or {{Robux|118}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|13,490}} or {{Robux|2,685}}.

==Appearance==
'''Easter Engineer Charm''' showcases the {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} [[Engineer]] holding a carrot while standing on a giant pot.

The color of the '''Easter Engineer Charm''' depends on the color of the player's name in chat, but it is purple in its preview in the inventory.

==Trivia==
*Despite being called the '''Easter Engineer Charm''', the skin it is based on is actually called the {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} [[Engineer]].
